Hi Anita — thanks for the docs and the clear summary. Quick responses below; copying internal folks to complete PO and payment setup.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can do reverse-charge treatment for EU/UK vendors where applicable. We need the VAT number on the invoice and one of the following: (a) explicit reverse-charge wording on the invoice, or (b) a reference to the applicable EU/UK VAT legislation.
- For PO mapping please include your full legal name, billing address, VAT number, and preferred remittance email. If you can include a company registration number that helps our vendor registry.
- Redwood does not require a US W-8 for UK vendors; instead we require a completed supplier onboarding form (link below) plus the VAT certificate you already sent.

Action items for you:
1) Please fill the onboarding form here: https://redwood.app/onboarding/form/ROSS-872 (one-page).
2) Attach a sample invoice that shows the tax lines as you'd normally send them (we can advise any formatting tweaks).

Finance (rishi) — once Anita confirms the sample invoice and we have the form, can we create PO 000872 and set the VAT treatment to "reverse charge" in the AP system? Please advise if you need any extra fields from Anita's side.

Legal (lauren) — FYI — if there is any additional compliance language we should require on the invoice for audit trail, please flag.

Thanks again — we want to make this as smooth as possible.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(attachment: onboarding_form_link)

Thanks everyone — I've reviewed the attachments. We can proceed with PO creation and reverse-charge setup with the following requirements:

1) PO: We'll issue PO 000872 to Rosslyn Enterprises Ltd with net amounts (VAT 0%) and a PO note: "Reverse charge—customer liable for VAT under UK/EU rules. VAT registration GB123456789." PO will include company code: RWINF-UK and cost center as discussed. (attachment: PO_000872_Rosslyn.pdf)

2) Invoice requirements for AP processing:
- Invoice must contain supplier legal name and billing address
- VAT registration number clearly shown
- A line in the invoice body or header stating: "Reverse charge applies — recipient liable for VAT (Art. 194 or local equivalent)."
- Bank details should match the bank file attached earlier; mismatches will delay payment.

3) Currency & remittance: Redwood will pay in GBP to the bank account provided. Payment terms 30 days from invoice receipt, unless otherwise negotiated.

Lauren — legal sign-off: are we good to accept the invoice language above for audit / SOC recordkeeping?

Anita — once you confirm you'll send invoices that include the reverse-charge line exactly as quoted above and the bank details match, we'll move the vendor from "pending" to "approved" and the PO will be released.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
